mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent.roadway (roadway_id, area_id, name, start_point, end_point, roadway_type, cross_section, status) VALUES (#{roadwayId}, #{areaId}, #{name}, #{startPoint}, #{endPoint}, #{roadwayType}, #{crossSection}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT roadway_id, area_id, name, start_point, end_point, roadway_type, cross_section, status FROM agent.roadway WHERE roadway_id = #{roadwayId}
SELECT roadway_id, area_id, name, start_point, end_point, roadway_type, cross_section, status FROM agent.roadway
